mainEntity.name: How long does a typical software development project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines depend on project scope, features, and complexity. Smaller projects usually take 2 to 4 weeks, while larger custom software solutions typically take 8 to 12 weeks. We confirm a realistic timeline during planning, before development begins.

mainEntity.name: How does the software development process begin with 4XCODE?

acceptedAnswer.text: It begins with a free demo or consultation call where we discuss your goals, challenges, and requirements. We then recommend the right approach and share a clear proposal covering scope, timeline, and next steps for your project.

mainEntity.name: Will I receive regular updates during development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work in agile sprints and share weekly progress updates, so you always know what has been completed, what is coming next, and can give feedback before each stage moves forward.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide support after the software is launched?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. After launch, we can provide ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, performance monitoring, and feature enhancements. Support arrangements are agreed according to your project needs, helping your software stay secure, stable, and ready to grow.
